Record Class MultiPolygon

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.model.geo.MultiPolygon
Record Components:
polygons - the polygons contained in this geometry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Geometry
@TypeDef(type=STRING, converter=GeometryJsonConverter.class) public record MultiPolygon(List<Polygon> polygons) extends Record implements Geometry
Represents a geometry composed of one or more Polygon values.

This type follows the GeoJSON MultiPolygon model and can be converted to nested polygon coordinate structures for serialization.

Since:
5.0
